title: Fix source-safe snapshots and scoped import pruning
description: Restore read-only source contract and prevent cross-source deletion during filtered imports. Blocked by executable specification task; verify regressions and full suite.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Synthetic audit confirmed source deletion when snapshot output aliases source, cross-agent pruning during selected-source imports, and automatic snapshot copies retained with permissive modes in shared temp roots. Fix all three with executable specifications and no real session fixtures. Implementation split by source/store ownership; documentation corrected separately.
